SYOKAMI Kitchen Knife Set

Previous page

Knife set package includes an 8-inch chef knife, a 7-inch Santoku knife, an 8-inch slicing knife, an 8-inch bread knife, a 6-inch utility knife, and a 3.8-inch paring knife.

Previous page
Next page

  • Is the kitchen knife set sharp? Will it rust?

    SYOKAMI knife set is made of high-carbon stainless steel with a Rockwell hardness of 56+, 15-degree blade angle on both sides, making every cut a masterpiece.

  • Can this knife set be put in a kitchen cabinet drawer?

    The folded height of this knife holder is only 2.56 inch, which can be easily stored in the cabinet to prevent children and pets from contact and injury, giving you and your family a safe kitchen experience.

  • Is the knife holder easy to clean?

    This knife holder adopts an open-slot design and a built-in magnetic device, which makes it easy to clean while ensuring safe storage of the knife. Compared with the fully enclosed knife holder on the market, it has fewer cleaning blind spots.

  • Is the knife set suitable for gifting?

    This knife set comes in an elegant and exquisite gift box. The set contains 6 knives with different functions, covering most kitchen knife needs. It is very suitable as a housewarming, birthday, anniversary and Christmas gift.
